description: AUTHORITATIVE flood-zone lookup: given a latitude/longitude, return the effective FEMA FIRM flood zone for that spot — the zone code (A, AE, AH, AO, VE, X, D), its subtype, whether it is in a Special Flood Hazard Area, the static base flood elevation, and the governing DFIRM id — plus nearby base flood elevation lines. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "is this address in a flood zone" or "does this property need flood insurance". Distinguishes "outside the floodplain" from "never mapped", which a plain empty result does not.

include_bfe.description: Also return base flood elevation lines within ~150 m of the point. Default true.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (negative in the US)

name: nfhl_flood_zone_at_point
title: Nfhl Flood Zone At Point
